title: Winged Sorceress in Storm
description: A female figure with long flowing turquoise hair and large mechanical wings flies dynamically through the center of a swirling turquoise tornado. She wears a form-fitting dark armored bodysuit and holds a glowing blue staff topped with a swirling energy orb, while ruined buildings, solar panels, and smaller winged figures are pulled into the vortex around her.
prompt: A powerful female sorceress with long flowing turquoise hair and large intricate mechanical wings flies through the center of a massive swirling turquoise tornado, wearing a sleek dark armored bodysuit, holding a glowing blue magical staff with an energy orb, surrounded by ruined buildings, floating solar panels, and smaller winged figures being swept up in the vortex under a dramatic stormy night sky
